statement: A record whose normalised status is 'rejected' MUST be excluded from an authored/captured node set built from a directory of records (e.g. ingest_dir semantics) -- a rejected decision is the option NOT taken, so it (and any assumptions attached to it) must never become ground truth.

valid_case.description: Directory of 2 records: one accepted, one rejected. Under REC-104 BOTH are retained — the accepted one as ground-truth intent, the rejected one as foreclosure intent, which must never be counted toward trust nor presented as something the team does.

invalid_case.description: A non-conformant implementation that DROPS the rejected record entirely. That was the pre-REC-104 behaviour; it destroys the record of a decision explicitly taken against, which is the question 'have we already declined this?'
invalid_case.reason: 0002-rejected.md's status normalises to 'rejected' (see REC-006). Including it promotes an explicitly-not-chosen option to ground truth.

note: Verified against whyfile.passes.ingest.ingest_dir(): ingesting this directory yields exactly 1 node, status='accepted'.
